docs.title: Purchasing, Receiving Goods, and Vendor Billing

sections.text: <!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0 -->

This chapter covers the end-to-end **Procure-to-Pay** workflow in ERPForAll—from raising a Request for Quotation (RFQ) and confirming a Purchase Order to receiving partial warehouse deliveries with backorders, generating a 3-way matched Vendor Bill, and processing vendor returns.

* **Purchase User**: Creates RFQs, manages product lines, and confirms orders within the company approval threshold. * **Purchase Administrator**: Approves orders exceeding the double-approval threshold (**Approve Order**), locks/unlocks confirmed orders, and configures Purchase Settings. * **Inventory User**: Validates incoming receipts and backorders under **Inventory → Operations → Receipts**. * **Accounting User**: Creates draft vendor bills from confirmed purchase orders, sets the **Bill Date**, posts bills to the Purchase journal, and registers vendor payments.

1. Clicking **Purchase** in the sidebar opens **Purchase Overview** (or open **Purchase → Orders → Requests for Quotation**). The top dashboard strip displays live icon counters for **RFQs**, **To Approve**, **Purchase Orders**, and **Waiting Bills** with an inline period selector—click any card to filter immediately. Click **+ New** to create an RFQ. 2. Select the **Vendor** (to browse your supplier directory directly, open **Purchase → Orders → Vendors**, which activates the **Vendors** filter chip by default) and check **Order Deadline**, **Expected Arrival**, **Currency**, and **Buyer**. 3. Under the **Products** tab, click **Add a line** and choose the product, **Quantity**, **Unit**, **Unit Price** (auto-filled when a Vendor Pricelist matches), and **Taxes**. 4. Click **Save**. ERPForAll assigns a purchase sequence number (for example, PO00023) and computes untaxed, tax, and grand totals.

1. Review vendor pricing and quantities on the RFQ and click **Confirm Order**. 2. If the order total is below the company approval threshold, it immediately becomes a **Purchase Order** and creates the incoming warehouse receipt (accessible from the **Receipt** smart button). 3. If the order reaches or exceeds your company's second-approval minimum (configured in **Purchase → Configuration → Settings**), the status moves to **To Approve** until a Purchase Administrator clicks **Approve Order**. ![A confirmed Purchase Order locks vendor and currency, displays its Purchase Order status, and links directly to the warehouse Receipt smart button.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/confirmed-po.webp)

When goods arrive at the receiving dock: 1. Click the **Receipt** smart button on the confirmed Purchase Order (or open **Inventory → Operations → Receipts** and match **Source Document** to your PO number). 2. Under **Detailed Operations**, update the **Quantity / Done** count to match the physical delivery (for example, entering 6 when 10 units were ordered). 3. Click **Validate**. 4. When received quantity is less than planned demand, the **Remaining demand** dialog prompts you to: * **Create Backorder**: Generates a linked open receipt for the remaining 4 units (Back Order of Main/IN/...). * **Close Remaining Demand / No Backorder**: Closes the receipt at 6 units without expecting further delivery. 5. Return to the Purchase Order: **Received Qty** reflects 6, and once the backorder receipt is validated for the remaining 4 units, **Received Qty** updates to 10 and the billing status becomes **Waiting Bills**. ![When receiving fewer items than ordered, the Remaining demand dialog lets you create a linked backorder receipt for the balance.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/backorder-dialog.webp)

1. On the confirmed Purchase Order with received quantities, click **Create Bill** (requires both Purchase and Accounting access rights). 2. ERPForAll opens a draft Vendor Bill populated with the received quantities, agreed PO prices, purchase taxes, an automatic default **Bill Date**, and **Purchase Match** status (showing **Matched** when ordered, received, and billed quantities align under 3-Way Matching). 3. Verify the vendor's **Bill Date** and invoice reference number, review line amounts against the physical supplier invoice, and click **Confirm** to post the bill (BILL/...). 4. Click **Register Payment** to settle the bill and move its status to **PAID**. Back on the PO, **Billed Qty** updates and status becomes **Fully Billed**. ![A Vendor Bill drafted from a Purchase Order verifies ordered, received, and billed quantities with Purchase Match: Matched.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/vendor-bill-3way-match.webp)

If received goods are damaged or rejected after validation: 1. Open the completed **Receipt** (Done) from the Purchase Order's **Receipt** smart button and click **Return**. 2. ERPForAll creates a reverse outgoing transfer (Return of Main/IN/... from Main/Stock to Vendors). 3. Click **Return All** to fill all received quantities at once, or enter a partial return **Demand** quantity on the move line (for example, 1 unit), then click **Confirm** and **Validate** to ship the returned items out of stock. 4. Record a matching **Vendor Refund / Credit Note** in Accounting if the vendor bill was already posted.

* **Adjusting Vendor Invoice Date**: Although **Create Bill** pre-populates **Bill Date** automatically, always adjust it to match the vendor's physical invoice date before clicking **Confirm** so aging and tax periods stay accurate. * **Warehouse Configuration Error on PO Confirmation**: Ensure the company has an active warehouse with a valid incoming operation type configured under **Inventory → Configuration → Warehouses** and **Operation Types**. * **Short-Receipt Billing**: When **Received Quantities** control is enabled, ERPForAll bills only the quantities actually validated on warehouse receipts. Validate pending backorders before billing the remainder. For a complete worked walkthrough from Blanket Agreement and Alternative RFQs through backorders, 3-way billing, payment, and returns, see [Purchasing Full-Cycle Example: Procure-to-Pay End-to-End](/en/next/user/purchasing-full-cycle-example.md).

docs.title: Purchase Agreements, Alternative RFQs, Pricelists, and Analytics

sections.text: <!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0 -->

Beyond single purchase orders, ERPForAll helps procurement teams standardize supplier pricing, run competitive tenders with Alternative RFQs, negotiate multi-period Blanket Agreements, enforce approval and 3-way match controls, and monitor spend through dynamic Purchase Reports.

Open **Purchase → Configuration → Settings** (requires Purchase Administrator / Settings Administration access) to configure company-wide procurement controls: * **Order Approval**: Require a manager's second approval (**Approve Order**) whenever a Purchase Order exceeds a configured monetary threshold (for example, $5,000). * **Lock Confirmed Orders**: Automatically lock confirmed POs against post-confirmation edits, or leave confirmed orders editable when buyers need flexibility. * **Three-Way Bill Matching**: Cross-check **Ordered**, **Received**, and **Billed** quantities on Vendor Bills so Accounts Payable sees at a glance whether a bill is **Matched** or requires exception review before payment. * **Days to Purchase**: Lead time buffer used by automated inventory replenishment to schedule RFQs ahead of stockouts. ![Purchase Settings centralizes approval thresholds, order locking, 3-way bill matching, and procurement lead times.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/purchase-settings.webp)

1. Open **Purchase → Products → Vendor Pricelists** to view all negotiated supplier prices across products. 2. Click **New** to define a vendor price rule: * **Vendor** and **Product** (plus optional vendor product name/code). * **Minimum Quantity**: Volume tier threshold (for example, 1 unit vs. 50 units bulk pricing). * **Unit Price**, **Currency**, **Delivery Lead Time (days)**, and optional **Validity** dates. 3. Whenever a buyer selects that product on a new RFQ—or when Inventory Replenishment auto-generates an RFQ—ERPForAll selects the best matching vendor and unit price automatically. ![Vendor Pricelists store volume tiers, currencies, negotiated unit prices, and supplier delivery lead times.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/vendor-pricelists.webp)

Use **Purchase Agreements** to lock in framework pricing and target quantities with a vendor over a contract period: 1. Open **Purchase → Orders → Purchase Agreements** and click **New**. 2. Choose the **Agreement Type** (*Blanket Order* or *Purchase Template*), select the **Vendor**, set contract dates, and add product lines with contracted quantities and unit prices. 3. Click **Save** and **Confirm** (assigning a sequence such as PA00001). 4. When you need a delivery call-off, create an RFQ linked to the agreement so contracted prices copy cleanly and ordered quantities accumulate against the agreement target. ![A confirmed Blanket Purchase Agreement tracks contracted vendor products, target quantities, and agreed unit prices.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/purchase-agreement.webp)

To solicit competitive bids from multiple suppliers for the same requirement: 1. Open a draft RFQ (for example, PO00023) and click **Alternative** (or **Create Alternative**). 2. Select an **Alternative Vendor** belonging to the active company (or a shared company-agnostic contact) and confirm to generate a linked alternative RFQ (for example, PO00024). 3. Enter each vendor's quoted unit prices and lead times on their respective RFQs. 4. Click **Compare Product Lines** (or open the **Alternatives** comparison view) to compare vendor quotes line by line—including unit price, quantity, currency, and expected arrival—and choose the winning line or RFQ to confirm. ![Alternative RFQ comparison displays competing vendor quotes side by side so buyers can select the best offer before confirming.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/compare-alternatives.webp)

Open **Purchase → Reporting** to monitor procurement performance across three built-in views: * **Purchase Report**: Dynamic hierarchical report summarizing total spend by vendor and purchase order with period filters, comparisons, drill-down, and PDF/XLSX export. Foreign-currency purchase orders convert at each order's stored exchange rate and round per order in the company currency so detail rows, vendor subtotals, and the grand total match accurately. * **Purchases by Product**: Tracks **Ordered**, **Received**, **Billed**, and **Untaxed** totals per product to highlight open receiving or billing backlogs. * **Purchase Pivot & Graph**: Interactive **List**, **Pivot**, and **Graph** analysis for slicing spend by vendor, buyer, product category, order date, or status. ![The Purchase Report rolls up total procurement spend by vendor and order with interactive filtering and export.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/purchase-report.webp)

* **Alternative Vendor Scope**: The **Alternative Vendor** picker is automatically scoped to contacts belonging to the active company (or shared company-agnostic contacts) to prevent cross-company posting errors. * **Filtering the Vendor Directory**: **Purchase → Orders → Vendors** applies the **Vendors** filter chip automatically (matching contacts with purchase orders or vendor pricelists). Click × on the chip if you need to view every contact in the database.
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0 -->

This worked walkthrough traces one procurement cycle across **Purchase**, **Inventory**, and **Accounting**—covering a Blanket Purchase Agreement, competing Alternative RFQs, partial warehouse receiving with a backorder, a 3-way matched Vendor Bill, bank settlement, and a defective-unit return.

| Parameter | Worked Example Value | | --- | --- | | **Blanket Agreement** | PA00001 (PT Global Komponen Indonesia, [ELK-MON24] Monitor 24 inci, Qty 20 @ $120.00) | | **Winning RFQ / PO** | PO00023 (Baja Sentosa Abadi, [ELK-MON24] Monitor 24 inci, Qty 10 @ $50.00 = $500.00) | | **Alternative RFQ** | PO00024 (PT Global Komponen Indonesia) compared side by side before awarding PO00023 | | **Warehouse Receipts** | Partial delivery Main/IN/00026 (6 units) + Backorder Main/IN/00027 (4 units) = 10 received | | **Vendor Bill & Payment** | BILL/2026/11/0022 ($500.00, Purchase Match: Matched) settled via PBNK1/2026/00032 | | **Return Case** | 1 defective monitor returned to vendor via Main/OUT/00024 |

1. **Create a Blanket Agreement (PA00001)**: * Open **Purchase → Orders → Purchase Agreements** and click **New**. * Select **Vendor** PT Global Komponen Indonesia, add [ELK-MON24] Monitor 24 inci for 20 units @ $120.00, click **Save**, and **Confirm**. 2. **Raise an RFQ (PO00023) and Competing Alternative (PO00024)**: * Open **Purchase → Orders → Requests for Quotation → New**. * Choose **Vendor** Baja Sentosa Abadi, add [ELK-MON24] Monitor 24 inci, **Quantity** 10, **Unit Price** $50.00 (Total $500.00), and **Save** (PO00023). * Click **Alternative**, select a same-company vendor (PT Global Komponen Indonesia), and create **PO00024**. * Open **Compare Product Lines** to review competing unit prices side by side before awarding PO00023. ![Confirmed Blanket Purchase Agreement PA00001 recording contracted quantities and unit pricing.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/purchase-agreement.webp) ![Alternative RFQ comparison view displaying PO00023 against PO00024 side by side so buyers can award the winning quote.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/compare-alternatives.webp)

1. Open the winning RFQ **PO00023** ($500.00, below the $5,000 second-approval threshold) and click **Confirm Order**. 2. Verify the immediate outcomes: * Status moves from **RFQ** to **Purchase Order**. * ERPForAll locks vendor and currency and generates incoming Receipt **Main/IN/00026** (Vendors → Main/Stock, Demand 10), accessible from the **1 Receipt** smart button. ![Confirmed Purchase Order PO00023 with Purchase Order status and 1 Receipt smart button linked to Main/IN/00026.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/confirmed-po.webp)

Suppose only 6 of the 10 monitors arrive on the first truck: 1. Click **1 Receipt** on PO00023 to open **Main/IN/00026**. 2. Switch to **Detailed Operations**, update **Quantity / Done** to **6**, and click **Validate**. 3. On the **Remaining demand** dialog, click **Create Backorder**. * Main/IN/00026 moves to **Done** (+6 units in Main/Stock). * ERPForAll creates linked backorder **Main/IN/00027** (Ready, Demand 4, Back Order of Main/IN/00026). * Returning to PO00023 shows **Received Qty = 6** and **2 Receipt**. 4. When the remaining 4 units arrive, open **Main/IN/00027**, verify 4 units, and click **Validate**. * PO00023 updates to **Received Qty = 10** and billing status **Waiting Bills**. ![Remaining demand dialog when validating 6 out of 10 units on Main/IN/00026, creating backorder Main/IN/00027.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/backorder-dialog.webp)

1. On PO00023 (now Received Qty = 10), click **Create Bill**. 2. ERPForAll drafts a Vendor Bill linked via **1 Purchase Orders** with: * 10 units × $50.00 = **$500.00** * **Purchase Match: Matched** (Ordered 10 = Received 10 = Billed 10 under Three-Way Matching). 3. Enter the supplier's **Bill Date** (for example, 11/26/2026), verify the invoice reference, and click **Confirm** to post **BILL/2026/11/0022**. * Accounting posts **Debit Inventory / Purchases $500.00** / **Credit Accounts Payable $500.00**. * Back on PO00023, **Billed Qty = 10** and billing status becomes **Fully Billed**. ![Draft Vendor Bill generated from PO00023 displaying Purchase Match: Matched across ordered, received, and billed quantities.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/vendor-bill-3way-match.webp)

1. On posted bill **BILL/2026/11/0022**, click **Register Payment**. 2. Choose **Journal**: Main Bank, verify **Amount**: $500.00, and click **Create Payment**. 3. Verify the settled bill: * Status badge shows **PAID** with **Amount Due = $0.00**, linked to **PBNK1/2026/00032**. * Accounting posts **Debit Accounts Payable $500.00** / **Credit Main Bank $500.00**. ![Settled Vendor Bill BILL/2026/11/0022 showing PAID badge, $0.00 Amount Due, and linked payment PBNK1/2026/00032.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/vendor-bill-paid.webp)

If 1 monitor from the second shipment (Main/IN/00027) fails inspection: 1. Open validated receipt **Main/IN/00027** (Done) and click **Return**. 2. ERPForAll creates Draft outgoing transfer **Main/OUT/00024** (Return of Main/IN/00027, Main/Stock → Vendors). 3. Set the stock move **Demand** to **1**, click **Confirm**, and click **Validate** to ship the defective unit back to the vendor (-1 unit from Main/Stock). 4. Issue a corresponding **Vendor Refund** (Accounting → Vendors → Refunds) if the supplier credits your account.

| Stage | Document Ref | Module | Stock Delta (Main/Stock) | Accounting Impact | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1. Blanket & Alt RFQ | PA00001, PO00023 / PO00024 | Purchase | 0 | None | | 2. Confirm PO | PO00023 (Purchase Order) | Purchase | 0 (10 incoming) | Optional Budget AVC commitment | | 3a. Partial Receipt | Main/IN/00026 (Done) | Inventory | **+6 units** | Inventory receipt | | 3b. Backorder Receipt | Main/IN/00027 (Done) | Inventory | **+4 units** | Inventory receipt | | 4. Vendor Bill | BILL/2026/11/0022 (Posted) | Accounting | 0 | Dr Purchases/Stock $500.00 / Cr Payable $500.00 | | 5. Vendor Payment | PBNK1/2026/00032 (Paid) | Accounting | 0 | Dr Payable $500.00 / Cr Bank $500.00 | | 6. Return Delivery | Main/OUT/00024 (Done) | Inventory | **-1 unit** | Inventory return outflow | | **Net Final Position** | — | **All** | **+9 net units kept** | **$500.00 settled (pending $50.00 vendor refund)** | Audit spend across suppliers in **Purchase → Reporting → Purchase Report**, **Purchases by Product**, and **Purchase Pivot & Graph**. ![Purchase Report confirming Baja Sentosa Abadi spend rolled up cleanly with drill-down to PO00023.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/purchase-report.webp)
